description: Hi everyone! I am Austen. I am passionate about learning, problem-solving, and collaborating on exciting academic and tech projects. I actively prepare for and participate in various math, science, and essay competitions. I value clear communication, teamwork, and making sure everyone's ideas are heard. For this team, I am looking for enthusiastic teammates who love coding, science, or logic puzzles and who enjoy collaborating and having fun while building cool things together.
